_schemaNote: Same schema assumption as run-tests-on-save.json: minimal Kiro hook shape (name, event, command, file pattern). Adapt to the installed Kiro version's exact hook schema if it differs; intent: grep for forbidden claims on save. The grep exits non-zero when nothing matches, hence the trailing `|| echo ...` so the hook reports success on a clean tree.
command: grep -rniE 'machine learning|real[- ]time (market|harga)|live market|harga pasar (real|live)|AI (price|pricing|vision)|computer vision' --include='*.html' --include='*.js' --include='*.md' index.html app.js src README.md .kiro/specs || echo 'honesty-check: no forbidden claims found'
description: On save of any UI/spec/doc file, grep for forbidden pricing claims (AI / machine learning / real-time market price). Every hit must be a denial ('bukan AI…') or be removed — see .kiro/agents/pricing-reviewer.md.
name: honesty-check-on-save
